message: Last week, we had a surprise power outage, and instead of panicking, I decided to embrace the moment. I pulled out my trusty flashlight and gathered the family for some good old-fashioned board games by lantern light. We laughed, shared stories, and even rediscovered some low-tech fun that we hadn’t done in ages! It was a lovely reminder that sometimes, a little darkness can spark creativity and connection. How do you keep the vibe alive during a blackout?
